modules.title: Additive NTT Algorithm
modules.doc:
Core Additive NTT data flow: evaluation points, twiddle factors, stage/update
definitions, coefficient tiling, and the stage invariant.

items.note:
## 2. The Additive NTT Algorithm and Correctness

This section describes the construction of the evaluation points,
the tiling of coefficients, the main loop invariant, and the final
correctness theorem for the Additive NTT algorithm.

items.name: AdditiveNTT.evaluationPointω
items.doc:
Constructs an evaluation point in `sDomain i` from its Nat.getBit representation.

The index is loose (`i : Fin r`); `h_i` records that it is an Additive-NTT level.
items.statement:
noncomputable def evaluationPointω (i : Fin r) (h_i : i ≤ ℓ)
    (x : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ + R_rate - i))) : L

items.name: AdditiveNTT.twiddleFactor
items.doc:
The twiddle factor at a strict NTT stage `i`.

It is the evaluation point with the stage bit set to zero, i.e. the `x₀` term of
the butterfly identity.
items.statement:
noncomputable def twiddleFactor (i : Fin r) (h_i : i < ℓ)
  (u : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ + R_rate - i - 1))) : L

items.name: AdditiveNTT.evaluationPointω_eq_twiddleFactor_of_div_2
items.statement:
lemma evaluationPointω_eq_twiddleFactor_of_div_2 (i : Fin r) (h_i : i < ℓ)
    (x : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ + R_rate - i))) :
  evaluationPointω 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := i) (h_i := by omega) x =
  twiddleFactor 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := i) (h_i := by omega) ⟨x/2, by
    have h := div_two_pow_lt_two_pow (x:=x) (i := ℓ + R_rate - i - 1) (j:=1) (by
      rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega)]; omega)
    simp only [pow_one] at h
    calc _ < 2 ^ (ℓ + R_rate - i - 1) := by omega
      _ = _ := by rfl
  ⟩ + (x.val % 2: ℕ) * eval (β ⟨i, by omega⟩) (normalizedW 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩)

items.name: AdditiveNTT.eval_point_ω_eq_next_twiddleFactor_comp_qmap
items.statement:
lemma eval_point_ω_eq_next_twiddleFactor_comp_qmap
    (i : Fin r) (h_i : i < ℓ) (x : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ + R_rate - (i + 1)))) :
  -- `j = u||b||v` => x here means u at level i
  evaluationPointω 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i.val+1, by omega⟩) (h_i := by simp only; omega) x =
  eval (twiddleFactor 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := i) (h_i := by omega) (u := ⟨x.val, by
    calc x.val < 2 ^ (ℓ + R_rate - (i.val + 1)) := by omega
      _ = 2 ^ (ℓ + R_rate - i.val - 1) := by rfl
  ⟩)) (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ (by change i.val + 1 < r; omega))

items.name: AdditiveNTT.tileCoeffs
items.doc:
The `2^R_rate`-fold tiling of coefficients `a` into the initial buffer `b`.
`b(v) = aⱼ`, where `j` are the `ℓ` LSBs of `v`.
items.statement: def tileCoeffs (a : Fin (2 ^ ℓ) → L) : Fin (2^(ℓ + R_rate)) → L

items.name: AdditiveNTT.NTTStage
items.doc:
A single Additive-NTT stage.

`i : Fin r` is a loose index, while `h_i : i < ℓ` restricts it to a stage of the
`for i from ℓ - 1 down to 0` loop.
items.statement:
noncomputable def NTTStage (i : Fin r) (h_i : i < ℓ) (b : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ + R_rate)) → L) :
    Fin (2^(ℓ + R_rate)) → L

items.name: AdditiveNTT.additiveNTT
items.doc:
**The Additive NTT Algorithm (Algorithm 2)**

Computes the Additive NTT on a given set of coefficients from the novel basis.
- `a`: The initial coefficient array `(a₀, ..., a_{2^ℓ-1})`.
items.statement: noncomputable def additiveNTT (a : Fin (2 ^ ℓ) → L) : Fin (2^(ℓ + R_rate)) → L

items.name: AdditiveNTT.coeffsBySuffix
items.doc:
The coefficients of the level-`i` polynomial selected by the low-bit suffix `v`.

The loose index `i : Fin r` is constrained by `h_i : i ≤ ℓ`; at `i = ℓ` this is
the initially tiled buffer.
items.statement:
def coeffsBySuffix (a : Fin (2 ^ ℓ) → L) (i : Fin r) (h_i : i ≤ ℓ) (v : Fin (2 ^ i.val)) :
    Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - i)) → L

items.name: AdditiveNTT.base_coeffsBySuffix
items.statement:
lemma base_coeffsBySuffix (a : Fin (2 ^ ℓ) → L) :
    coeffsBySuffix (r:=r) (R_rate := R_rate) (a := a) (i := 0)
    (h_i := by simp only [Fin.coe_ofNat_eq_mod,
    Nat.zero_mod, zero_le]) 0 = a

items.name: AdditiveNTT.evenRefinement_eq_novel_poly_of_0_leading_suffix
items.doc:
`P₀, ₍ᵥ₎⁽ⁱ⁺¹⁾(X) = P₍₀ᵥ₎⁽ⁱ⁺¹⁾(X)`, where `v` consists of exactly `i` bits
Note that the even refinement `P₀, ₍ᵥ₎⁽ⁱ⁺¹⁾(X)` is constructed from the view of
stage `i`, while the novel polynomial `P₍₀ᵥ₎⁽ⁱ⁺¹⁾(X)` is constructed from the view of stage `i+1`.
items.statement:
theorem evenRefinement_eq_novel_poly_of_0_leading_suffix (i : Fin r) (h_i : i < ℓ)
    (v : Fin (2 ^ i.val))
    (original_coeffs : Fin (2 ^ ℓ) → L) :
    have h_v: v.val < 2 ^ (i.val + 1) := by
      calc v.val < 2 ^ i.val

items.name: AdditiveNTT.oddRefinement_eq_novel_poly_of_1_leading_suffix
items.doc:
`P₁, ₍ᵥ₎⁽ⁱ⁺¹⁾(X) = P₍₁ᵥ₎⁽ⁱ⁺¹⁾(X)`, where `v` consists of exactly `i` bits
Note that the odd refinement `P₁,₍ᵥ₎⁽ⁱ⁺¹⁾(X)` is constructed from the view of stage `i`,
while the novel polynomial `P₍₁ᵥ₎⁽ⁱ⁺¹⁾(X)` is constructed from the view of stage `i+1`.
items.statement:
theorem oddRefinement_eq_novel_poly_of_1_leading_suffix (i : Fin r) (h_i : i < ℓ)
    (v : Fin (2 ^ i.val))
    (original_coeffs : Fin (2 ^ ℓ) → L) :
    have h_v: v.val ||| (1 <<< i.val) < 2 ^ (i.val + 1) := by
      apply Nat.or_lt_two_pow (x:=v.val) (y:=1 <<< i.val) (n:=i.val + 1) (by omega)
      rw [Nat.shiftLeft_eq, one_mul]
      exact Nat.pow_lt_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)
    oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i h_i (coeffsBySuffix (r:=r) (R_rate:=R_rate)
      original_coeffs (i := i) (h_i := by omega) v) =
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i.val + 1, by omega⟩)
      (h_i := by simp only; omega)
      (coeffsBySuffix (r:=r) (R_rate:=R_rate) original_coeffs
        (i := ⟨i.val+1, by omega⟩) (h_i := by simp only; omega)
        ⟨v ||| (1 <<< i.val), h_v⟩)

items.name: AdditiveNTT.additiveNTTInvariant
items.doc:
The main loop invariant for the `additiveNTT` algorithm: the evaluation buffer `b`
at the end of level `i` (`i ∈ {0, ..., ℓ}`, `i=ℓ` means the initial tiled buffer)
holds the value `P⁽ⁱ⁾(ω_{u, b, i})` for all Nat.getBit mask index
`(u||b||v) ∈ {0, ..., 2^(ℓ+R_rate)-1}`, where the points `ω_{u, b, i}` are in the domain `S⁽ⁱ⁾`.

**Main statement:**
After round `i ∈ {ℓ-1, ℓ-2, ..., 0}`: the buffer `b` at index `j` (which can be
decomposed as `j = (u || b || v)` in little-endian order, where
- `u` is a bitstring of length `ℓ + R_rate - i - 1`,
- `b` is a single Nat.getBit (the LSB of the high bits),
- `v` is a bitstring of length `i` (the LSBs),
holds the value `P⁽ⁱ⁾(ω_{u, b, i})`,
where:
  - `P⁽ⁱ⁾` is the intermediate polynomial at round `i` (in the novel basis),
  - `ω_{u, b, i}` is the evaluation point in the subspace `S⁽ⁱ⁾` constructed
  as a linear combination of the basis elements of `S⁽ⁱ⁾`:
    - the Nat.getBit `b` is the coefficient for `Ŵᵢ(βᵢ)` (the LSB),
    - the LSB of `u` is the coefficient for `Ŵᵢ(β_{i+1})`, ..., the MSB of `u` is
    the coefficient for `Ŵᵢ(β_{ℓ+R_rate-1})`.
  - The value is replicated `2^i` times for each `v`
    (i.e., the last `i` bits do not affect the value).

More precisely, for all `j : Fin (2^(ℓ + R_rate))`,
let `u_b_v := j.val` (as a natural number),
- let `v := u_b_v % 2^i` (the `i` LSBs),
- let `u_b := u_b_v / 2^i` (the high bits),
- let `b := u_b % 2` (the LSB of the high bits),
- let `u := u_b / 2` (the remaining high bits),
then:
  b j = P⁽ⁱ⁾(ω_{u, b, i})
items.statement:
def additiveNTTInvariant (evaluation_buffer : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ + R_rate)) → L)
    (original_coeffs : Fin (2 ^ ℓ) → L) (i : Fin r) (h_i : i ≤ ℓ) : Prop

modules.title: Additive NTT Correctness
modules.doc:
The stage-wise correctness argument and the final correctness theorem for the
Additive NTT.

items.name: AdditiveNTT.run_foldlM_modify_eq_foldl
items.doc:
Running a state fold made only of state updates gives the same final state as
the corresponding pure fold.
items.statement:
lemma run_foldlM_modify_eq_foldl {σ : Type} (n : Nat) (f : σ → Fin n → σ) (init : σ) :
    ((Fin.foldlM (m := StateM σ) (n := n)
      (f := fun (_ : Unit) i => do
        modifyThe σ fun current => f current i
        pure ()) (init := ())).run init).2 =
      Fin.foldl n f init

items.name: AdditiveNTT.bitsToU_bijective
items.doc:
The `bitsToU` mapping is a bijection: showing that iterating bits corresponds
exactly to the linear span.
items.statement:
theorem bitsToU_bijective (i : Fin r) :
    Function.Bijective (bitsToU (𝔽q := 𝔽q) (β := β) (ℓ := ℓ) (R_rate := R_rate) i)

items.name: AdditiveNTT.evalWAt_eq_W
items.doc: Prove that `evalWAt` equals the standard definition of `W_i(x)`.
items.statement:
theorem evalWAt_eq_W (i : Fin r) (x : L) :
    evalWAt (β := β) (ℓ := ℓ) (R_rate := R_rate) (i := i) x =
    (W (𝔽q := 𝔽q) (β := β) (i := i)).eval x

items.name: AdditiveNTT.evalNormalizedWAt_eq_normalizedW
items.doc: Prove that `evalNormalizedWAt` equals the standard definition of `Ŵ_i(x)`.
items.statement:
theorem evalNormalizedWAt_eq_normalizedW (i : Fin r) (x : L) :
    evalNormalizedWAt (β := β) (ℓ := ℓ) (R_rate := R_rate) (i := i) x
    = (normalizedW (𝔽q := 𝔽q) (β := β) (i := i)).eval x

items.name: AdditiveNTT.computableTwiddleFactor_eq_twiddleFactor
items.doc: Prove that `computableTwiddleFactor` equals the standard definition of `twiddleFactor`.
items.statement:
theorem computableTwiddleFactor_eq_twiddleFactor (i : Fin ℓ) :
    computableTwiddleFactor (r := r) (ℓ := ℓ) (β := β) (L := L)
    (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) =
  twiddleFactor (𝔽q := 𝔽q) (L := L) (β := β) (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by exact i.isLt)

items.name: AdditiveNTT.computableNTTStage_eq_NTTStage
items.doc: Prove that `computableNTTStage` equals the standard definition of `NTTStage`.
items.statement:
theorem computableNTTStage_eq_NTTStage (i : Fin ℓ) :
    computableNTTStage (𝔽q := 𝔽q) (r := r) (L := L) (ℓ := ℓ) (β := β) (R_rate := R_rate)
    (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) =
  NTTStage (𝔽q := 𝔽q) (L := L) (β := β) (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by exact i.isLt)

items.name: AdditiveNTT.W_eval_succ_eq_mul_add
items.doc:
In the binary-field setting, the subspace vanishing polynomials satisfy the
runtime recurrence used by `evalWAtCachedConstants`.
items.statement:
lemma W_eval_succ_eq_mul_add (i : Fin r) (h_i_add_1 : i + 1 < r) (x : L) :
    (W (𝔽q := 𝔽q) (β := β) (i := i + 1)).eval x =
      (W (𝔽q := 𝔽q) (β := β) (i := i)).eval x *
        ((W (𝔽q := 𝔽q) (β := β) (i := i)).eval x +
          (W (𝔽q := 𝔽q) (β := β) (i := i)).eval (β i))

items.name: AdditiveNTT.evalWAtCachedConstantsLoop_eq_W_of_correct
items.doc:
The cached evaluator computes `W_i(x)` when the cache stores exactly
`W_k(β_k)` for `k < i`. This is stated for the internal loop so later proofs can
resume from a partially consumed cache.
items.statement:
lemma evalWAtCachedConstantsLoop_eq_W_of_correct (constants : Array L) (i : Fin r)
    (j : Nat) (x acc : L)
    (hsize : constants.size = i.val) (hj_le : j ≤ i.val) (hj_lt_r : j < r)
    (hacc : acc = (W (𝔽q := 𝔽q) (β := β) (i := ⟨j, hj_lt_r⟩)).eval x)
    (hcorrect : ∀ k, j ≤ k → (hki : k < i.val) →
      constants.getD k 0 =
        (W (𝔽q := 𝔽q) (β := β) (i := ⟨k, Nat.lt_trans hki i.isLt⟩)).eval
          (β ⟨k, Nat.lt_trans hki i.isLt⟩)) :
    evalWAtCachedConstantsLoop constants j acc =
      (W (𝔽q := 𝔽q) (β := β) (i := i)).eval x

items.name: AdditiveNTT.evalWAtCachedConstants_eq_W_of_correct
items.doc: The cached evaluator computes `W_i(x)` from a complete cache for stage `i`.
items.statement:
lemma evalWAtCachedConstants_eq_W_of_correct (constants : Array L) (i : Fin r) (x : L)
    (hsize : constants.size = i.val)
    (hcorrect : ∀ k, (hki : k < i.val) →
      constants.getD k 0 =
        (W (𝔽q := 𝔽q) (β := β) (i := ⟨k, Nat.lt_trans hki i.isLt⟩)).eval
          (β ⟨k, Nat.lt_trans hki i.isLt⟩)) :
    evalWAtCachedConstants constants x =
      (W (𝔽q := 𝔽q) (β := β) (i := i)).eval x

items.name: AdditiveNTT.subspacePolynomialConstantsArrayLoop_spec
items.doc:
The constants-array builder preserves the invariant that entry `k` stores
`W_k(β_k)`, and finishes with one entry for every `k < i`.
items.statement:
lemma subspacePolynomialConstantsArrayLoop_spec (i : Fin r) (k : Nat) (constants : Array L)
    (hsize : constants.size = k) (hk_le : k ≤ i.val)
    (hcorrect : ∀ m, (hmk : m < k) →
      constants.getD m 0 =
        (W (𝔽q := 𝔽q) (β := β) (i := ⟨m, by omega⟩)).eval (β ⟨m, by omega⟩)) :
    let result := subspacePolynomialConstantsArrayLoop (β := β) (ℓ := ℓ)
      (R_rate := R_rate) i k constants
    result.size = i.val ∧
      ∀ m, (hmi : m < i.val) →
        result.getD m 0 =
          (W (𝔽q := 𝔽q) (β := β) (i := ⟨m, Nat.lt_trans hmi i.isLt⟩)).eval
            (β ⟨m, Nat.lt_trans hmi i.isLt⟩)

items.name: AdditiveNTT.subspacePolynomialConstantsArrayLoop_size
items.statement:
lemma subspacePolynomialConstantsArrayLoop_size (i : Fin r) (k : Nat) (constants : Array L)
    (hsize : constants.size = k) (hk_le : k ≤ i.val) :
    (subspacePolynomialConstantsArrayLoop (β := β) (ℓ := ℓ)
      (R_rate := R_rate) i k constants).size = i.val

items.name: AdditiveNTT.subspacePolynomialConstantsArray_size
items.statement:
lemma subspacePolynomialConstantsArray_size (i : Fin r) :
    (subspacePolynomialConstantsArray (β := β) (ℓ := ℓ) (R_rate := R_rate) i).size =
      i.val

items.name: AdditiveNTT.subspacePolynomialConstantsArray_getD
items.statement:
lemma subspacePolynomialConstantsArray_getD (i : Fin r) (m : Nat) (hm : m < i.val) :
    (subspacePolynomialConstantsArray (β := β) (ℓ := ℓ) (R_rate := R_rate) i).getD m 0 =
      (W (𝔽q := 𝔽q) (β := β) (i := ⟨m, Nat.lt_trans hm i.isLt⟩)).eval
        (β ⟨m, Nat.lt_trans hm i.isLt⟩)

items.name: AdditiveNTT.evalWAtCachedConstants_subspacePolynomialConstantsArray_eq_W
items.statement:
lemma evalWAtCachedConstants_subspacePolynomialConstantsArray_eq_W (i : Fin r) (x : L) :
    evalWAtCachedConstants
      (subspacePolynomialConstantsArray (β := β) (ℓ := ℓ) (R_rate := R_rate) i) x =
      (W (𝔽q := 𝔽q) (β := β) (i := i)).eval x

items.name: AdditiveNTT.computableNormalizedWValuesArray_getD
items.statement:
lemma computableNormalizedWValuesArray_getD (i : Fin ℓ)
    (k : Fin (ℓ + R_rate - i - 1)) :
    (computableNormalizedWValuesArray (β := β) (ℓ := ℓ) (R_rate := R_rate)
      (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) (i := i)).getD k.val 0 =
      (normalizedW (𝔽q := 𝔽q) (β := β) (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩)).eval
        (β ⟨i + 1 + k.val, by omega⟩)

items.name: AdditiveNTT.computableTwiddleTableArray_getD
items.statement:
lemma computableTwiddleTableArray_getD (i : Fin ℓ)
    (u : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ + R_rate - i - 1))) :
    (computableTwiddleTableArray (β := β) (ℓ := ℓ) (R_rate := R_rate)
      (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) (i := i)).getD u.val 0 =
      twiddleFactor (𝔽q := 𝔽q) (L := L) (ℓ := ℓ) (R_rate := R_rate)
        (β := β) (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩)
        (h_i := by exact i.isLt) (u := u)

items.name: AdditiveNTT.arrayToFinFunction_tileCoeffsArray
items.statement:
lemma arrayToFinFunction_tileCoeffsArray (a : Fin (2 ^ ℓ) → L) :
    arrayToFinFunction (2 ^ (ℓ + R_rate))
      (tileCoeffsArray (L := L) (ℓ := ℓ) R_rate a) =
      tileCoeffs (L := L) (ℓ := ℓ) (R_rate := R_rate) a

items.name: AdditiveNTT.computableNTTStageArray_eq_computableNTTStage
items.statement:
lemma computableNTTStageArray_eq_computableNTTStage (i : Fin ℓ) (b : Array L) :
    arrayToFinFunction (2 ^ (ℓ + R_rate))
        (computableNTTStageArray (L := L) (ℓ := ℓ) (R_rate := R_rate)
          (i := i)
          (twiddles := computableTwiddleTableArray (β := β) (ℓ := ℓ)
            (R_rate := R_rate) (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) (i := i)) b) =
      computableNTTStage (𝔽q := 𝔽q) (r := r) (L := L) (ℓ := ℓ) (R_rate := R_rate)
        (β := β) (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩)
        (b := arrayToFinFunction (2 ^ (ℓ + R_rate)) b)

items.name: AdditiveNTT.computableAdditiveNTT_eq_additiveNTT
items.doc:
The proof-oriented computable additive NTT agrees with the abstract
additive NTT specification.
items.statement:
theorem computableAdditiveNTT_eq_additiveNTT (a : Fin (2 ^ ℓ) → L) :
    computableAdditiveNTT (𝔽q := 𝔽q) (L := L) (r := r) (β := β)
      (ℓ := ℓ) (R_rate := R_rate) (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) (a := a) =
    additiveNTT (𝔽q := 𝔽q) (L := L) (β := β)
      (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) (a := a)

items.name: AdditiveNTT.computableAdditiveNTTFastAction_run_eq_fold
items.statement:
lemma computableAdditiveNTTFastAction_run_eq_fold (a : Fin (2 ^ ℓ) → L) :
    ((computableAdditiveNTTFastAction (L := L) (r := r) (β := β)
      (ℓ := ℓ) (R_rate := R_rate) (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) a).run #[]).1 =
    Fin.foldl (n := ℓ) (fun current i =>
      let stage : Fin ℓ := ⟨ℓ - i - 1, by omega⟩
      let twiddles := computableTwiddleTableArray (β := β) (ℓ := ℓ)
        (R_rate := R_rate) (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) (i := stage)
      computableNTTStageArray (ℓ := ℓ) (R_rate := R_rate)
        (i := stage) (twiddles := twiddles) current)
      (tileCoeffsArray (L := L) (ℓ := ℓ) R_rate a)

items.name: AdditiveNTT.computableAdditiveNTTFast_eq_computableAdditiveNTT
items.doc:
The fast additive NTT array implementation is extensionally equal to the
proof-oriented computable implementation after converting its output array to a
`Fin`-indexed function.

This is the preferred proof boundary for the fast path: once this theorem is
proved, correctness against the abstract additive NTT specification follows from
`computableAdditiveNTT_eq_additiveNTT`.
items.statement:
theorem computableAdditiveNTTFast_eq_computableAdditiveNTT (a : Fin (2 ^ ℓ) → L) :
    AdditiveNTT.arrayToFinFunction (2^(ℓ + R_rate))
      (computableAdditiveNTTFast (L := L) (r := r) (β := β)
        (ℓ := ℓ) (R_rate := R_rate) (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) (a := a)) =
    computableAdditiveNTT (𝔽q := 𝔽q) (L := L) (r := r) (β := β)
      (ℓ := ℓ) (R_rate := R_rate) (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) (a := a)

items.name: AdditiveNTT.computableAdditiveNTTFast_eq_additiveNTT
items.doc:
The fast additive NTT array implementation is correct against the abstract
additive NTT specification after converting its output array to a `Fin`-indexed
function.
items.statement:
theorem computableAdditiveNTTFast_eq_additiveNTT (a : Fin (2 ^ ℓ) → L) :
    AdditiveNTT.arrayToFinFunction (2^(ℓ + R_rate))
      (computableAdditiveNTTFast (L := L) (r := r) (β := β)
        (ℓ := ℓ) (R_rate := R_rate) (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) (a := a)) =
    additiveNTT (𝔽q := 𝔽q) (L := L) (β := β)
      (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) (a := a)

items.name: AdditiveNTT.initial_tiled_coeffs_correctness
items.statement:
lemma initial_tiled_coeffs_correctness (h_ℓ : ℓ ≤ r) (a : Fin (2 ^ ℓ) → L) :
    let b: Fin (2^(ℓ + R_rate)) → L := tileCoeffs a
    additiveNTTInvariant 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate b a (i := ⟨ℓ, by omega⟩)
      (h_i := by change ℓ ≤ ℓ; omega)

items.name: AdditiveNTT.NTTStage_correctness
items.doc:
The correctness theorem for the `NTTStage` function. This is the inductive step
in the main proof. It asserts that if the invariant holds for `i+1`, then after
applying `NTTStage i`, the invariant holds for `i ∈ {0, ..., ℓ-1}`.
items.statement:
lemma NTTStage_correctness (i : Fin (ℓ))
    (input_buffer : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ + R_rate)) → L) (original_coeffs : Fin (2 ^ ℓ) → L) :
    additiveNTTInvariant 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (evaluation_buffer:=input_buffer)
      (original_coeffs:=original_coeffs) (i := ⟨i.val + 1, by omega⟩)
        (h_i := by change i.val + 1 ≤ ℓ; omega) →
    additiveNTTInvariant 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (evaluation_buffer:=NTTStage 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate
      (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by simp only; omega) input_buffer)
      (original_coeffs:=original_coeffs) (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩)
        (h_i := by change i.val ≤ ℓ; omega)

items.name: AdditiveNTT.foldl_NTTStage_inductive_aux
items.statement:
lemma foldl_NTTStage_inductive_aux (h_ℓ : ℓ ≤ r) (k : Fin (ℓ + 1))
    (original_coeffs : Fin (2 ^ ℓ) → L) :
    additiveNTTInvariant 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate
    (Fin.foldl k (fun current_b i ↦ NTTStage 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate
      (i := ⟨ℓ - i -1, by omega⟩) (h_i := by simp only; omega) current_b)
      (tileCoeffs original_coeffs))
    original_coeffs ⟨ℓ - k, by omega⟩ (by change ℓ - k.val ≤ ℓ; omega)

items.name: AdditiveNTT.additiveNTT_correctness
items.doc:
**Main Correctness Theorem for Additive NTT**
If `b` is the output of `additiveNTT` on input `a`, then for all `j`, `b j`
is the evaluation of the polynomial `P` (from the novel basis coefficients `a`)
at the evaluation point `ω_{0, j}` in the domain `S⁰`.
items.statement:
theorem additiveNTT_correctness (h_ℓ : ℓ ≤ r)
    (original_coeffs : Fin (2 ^ ℓ) → L)
    (output_buffer : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ + R_rate)) → L)
    (h_alg : output_buffer = additiveNTT 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate original_coeffs) :
    let P := polynomialFromNovelCoeffs 𝔽q β ℓ h_ℓ original_coeffs
    ∀ (j : Fin (2^(ℓ + R_rate))),
      output_buffer j = P.eval (evaluationPointω 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate
        (i := ⟨0, by omega⟩) (h_i := by simp only; omega) j)

modules.title: The additive NTT over a coset, and its inverse
modules.doc:
The transform of Lin, Chung and Han (FOCS 2014), over any coset shift + S_l.

The other files here follow Diamond and Posen: one transform over S_l, tiled for the rate.

`CosetBridge.lean` shows these objects agree with those of the other files.

## Main results

- `vanishing_add`: W_i is additive in characteristic 2 (Lemma 1).
- `network_ntt`: the butterfly network evaluates the novel-basis polynomial on the coset.
- `inetwork_network`: the inverse network undoes the network.
- `inetwork_ntt`: the inverse network recovers the coefficients.
- `ntt_pad`: zero-padded coefficients split into one transform per coset of S_m.
- `normalized_eq_sqAddIter`: for a Cantor basis, W^_j is the j-th iterate of x^2 + x.

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.point
items.doc: Point m of the span of the basis: the sum of beta_r over the set bits r of m.
items.statement: def point (β : ℕ → F) (m : ℕ) : F

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.vanishing
items.doc: The subspace polynomial W_i: the product of x - s over the 2^i points s of S_i.
items.statement: def vanishing (β : ℕ → F) (i : ℕ) (x : F) : F

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.normalized
items.doc: The normalised subspace polynomial W_i(x) / W_i(beta_i).
items.statement: def normalized (β : ℕ → F) (i : ℕ) (x : F) : F

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.novel
items.doc: The novel basis polynomial X_k of the first l normalised subspace polynomials.
items.statement: def novel (β : ℕ → F) (l k : ℕ) (x : F) : F

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.novelEval
items.doc: The value at x of sum_(k < 2^l) d_k X_k.
items.statement: def novelEval (β : ℕ → F) (l : ℕ) (d : ℕ → V) (x : F) : V

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.ntt
items.doc: The additive NTT over shift + S_l: entry i is sum_k d_k X_k at shift + point(i).
items.statement: def ntt (β : ℕ → F) (l : ℕ) (shift : F) (d : ℕ → V) : ℕ → V

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.Independent
items.doc: No beta_i, for i < n, is a point of the span of the earlier ones.
items.statement: def Independent (β : ℕ → F) (n : ℕ) : Prop

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.IsCantor
items.doc: A Cantor basis of length n: beta_0 = 1 and beta_i^2 + beta_i = beta_(i-1) for 0 < i < n.
items.statement: def IsCantor (β : ℕ → F) (n : ℕ) : Prop

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.butterfly
items.doc: The forward butterfly (u, v) -> (u + t v, u + t v + v).
items.statement: def butterfly (t : F) (u v : V) : V × V

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.ibutterfly
items.doc: The inverse butterfly (u, v) -> (u + t (u + v), u + v).
items.statement: def ibutterfly (t : F) (u v : V) : V × V

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.stage
items.doc:
Stage j of the forward network.

Row i pairs with the row 2^j away, inside its block of 2^(j+1) rows.

Block b uses the twiddle tau(b).
items.statement: def stage (τ : ℕ → F) (j : ℕ) (x : ℕ → V) : ℕ → V

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.istage
items.doc: Stage j of the inverse network, pairing rows as the forward stage does.
items.statement: def istage (τ : ℕ → F) (j : ℕ) (x : ℕ → V) : ℕ → V

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.network
items.doc: The forward network of l stages, stage l - 1 first, stage j with twiddles tau_j.
items.statement: def network (τ : ℕ → ℕ → F) : ℕ → (ℕ → V) → ℕ → V

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.inetwork
items.doc: The inverse network of l stages: stage 0 first, up to stage l - 1.
items.statement: def inetwork (τ : ℕ → ℕ → F) : ℕ → (ℕ → V) → ℕ → V

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.twiddle
items.doc: The twiddle of stage j and block b over shift + S: W^_j at the block's first point.
items.statement: def twiddle (β : ℕ → F) (shift : F) (j b : ℕ) : F

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.sqAddIter
items.doc: The iterated map x -> x^2 + x, which is W_j for a Cantor basis.
items.statement: def sqAddIter (j : ℕ) (x : F) : F

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.point_eq_sum
items.doc: Point m as a sum over any range of bits that covers m.
items.statement:
theorem point_eq_sum (β : ℕ → F) {m n : ℕ} (hm : m < 2 ^ n) :
    point β m = ∑ r ∈ range n, if m.testBit r then β r else 0

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.point_zero
items.statement: theorem point_zero (β : ℕ → F) : point β 0 = 0

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.point_two_pow
items.statement: theorem point_two_pow (β : ℕ → F) (j : ℕ) : point β (2 ^ j) = β j

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.point_add_mul
items.doc: Bits below 2^k and bits above it contribute separately.
items.statement:
theorem point_add_mul (β : ℕ → F) (a k : ℕ) {b : ℕ} (hb : b < 2 ^ k) :
    point β (2 ^ k * a + b) = point β (2 ^ k * a) + point β b

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.point_add_two_pow
items.statement:
theorem point_add_two_pow (β : ℕ → F) {m k : ℕ} (hm : m < 2 ^ k) :
    point β (m + 2 ^ k) = point β m + β k

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.point_mul_two_pow
items.doc: Point m of a shifted basis is point m 2^s of the basis.
items.statement:
theorem point_mul_two_pow (β : ℕ → F) (m s : ℕ) :
    point β (2 ^ s * m) = point (fun r => β (s + r)) m

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.point_congr
items.doc: Point m only reads the basis vectors below the bit length of m.
items.statement:
theorem point_congr {β β' : ℕ → F} {m n : ℕ} (hm : m < 2 ^ n) (h : ∀ r < n, β r = β' r) :
    point β m = point β' m

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.map_point
items.doc: An additive map sends point m of a basis to point m of the image basis.
items.statement: theorem map_point (f : F →+ F) (β : ℕ → F) (m : ℕ) : f (point β m) = point (f ∘ β) m

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.point_two_pow_sub_one
items.doc: With every bit below t set, point (2^t - 1) is the sum of the first t basis vectors.
items.statement:
theorem point_two_pow_sub_one (β : ℕ → F) (t : ℕ) :
    point β (2 ^ t - 1) = ∑ q ∈ range t, β q

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.vanishing_zero
items.statement: theorem vanishing_zero (x : F) : vanishing β 0 x = x

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.vanishing_succ
items.statement:
theorem vanishing_succ (i : ℕ) (x : F) :
    vanishing β (i + 1) x = vanishing β i x * vanishing β i (x - β i)

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.vanishing_point
items.statement: theorem vanishing_point {i m : ℕ} (hm : m < 2 ^ i) : vanishing β i (point β m) = 0

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.vanishing_basis_ne_zero
items.doc: The scaling factor of the normalisation is nonzero for an independent basis.
items.statement:
theorem vanishing_basis_ne_zero {n i : ℕ} (hβ : Independent β n) (hi : i < n) :
    vanishing β i (β i) ≠ 0

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.vanishing_add
items.doc: Lin, Chung and Han, Lemma 1: W_i is additive in characteristic 2.
items.statement:
theorem vanishing_add (i : ℕ) (x y : F) :
    vanishing β i (x + y) = vanishing β i x + vanishing β i y

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.vanishingHom
items.doc: W_i as an additive map.
items.statement: def vanishingHom (i : ℕ) : F →+ F

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.vanishing_succ'
items.statement:
theorem vanishing_succ' (i : ℕ) (x : F) :
    vanishing β (i + 1) x = vanishing β i x * (vanishing β i x + vanishing β i (β i))

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.normalized_add
items.statement:
theorem normalized_add (i : ℕ) (x y : F) :
    normalized β i (x + y) = normalized β i x + normalized β i y

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.normalized_basis
items.statement:
theorem normalized_basis {n i : ℕ} (hβ : Independent β n) (hi : i < n) :
    normalized β i (β i) = 1

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.normalized_point
items.statement: theorem normalized_point {i m : ℕ} (hm : m < 2 ^ i) : normalized β i (point β m) = 0

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.normalized_shift_low
items.doc: W^_l is constant on a coset of S_l.
items.statement:
theorem normalized_shift_low (l : ℕ) (shift : F) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < 2 ^ l) :
    normalized β l (shift + point β i) = normalized β l shift

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.normalized_shift_high
items.doc: W^_l rises by one on the next coset of S_l.
items.statement:
theorem normalized_shift_high {n l : ℕ} (hβ : Independent β n) (hl : l < n) (shift : F)
    {i : ℕ} (hi : i < 2 ^ l) :
    normalized β l (shift + point β (i + 2 ^ l)) = normalized β l shift + 1

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.novel_succ_low
items.statement:
theorem novel_succ_low (l : ℕ) {k : ℕ} (hk : k < 2 ^ l) (x : F) :
    novel β (l + 1) k x = novel β l k x

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.novel_succ_high
items.statement:
theorem novel_succ_high (l : ℕ) {k : ℕ} (hk : k < 2 ^ l) (x : F) :
    novel β (l + 1) (k + 2 ^ l) x = novel β l k x * normalized β l x

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.sqAddIter_succ
items.statement:
theorem sqAddIter_succ (j : ℕ) (x : F) :
    sqAddIter (j + 1) x = sqAddIter j x ^ 2 + sqAddIter j x

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.sqAddIter_basis
items.doc: The iterate sends beta_i to beta_(i-j).
items.statement:
theorem sqAddIter_basis {n : ℕ} (hβ : IsCantor β n) {i j : ℕ} (hi : i < n) (hj : j ≤ i) :
    sqAddIter j (β i) = β (i - j)

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.vanishing_eq_sqAddIter
items.doc: For a Cantor basis, W_j is the j-th iterate of x^2 + x.
items.statement:
theorem vanishing_eq_sqAddIter {n : ℕ} (hβ : IsCantor β n) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ n) (x : F) :
    vanishing β j x = sqAddIter j x

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.vanishing_basis_cantor
items.statement:
theorem vanishing_basis_cantor {n : ℕ} (hβ : IsCantor β n) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < n) :
    vanishing β j (β j) = 1

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.IsCantor.independent
items.doc: A Cantor basis is independent.
items.statement: theorem IsCantor.independent {n : ℕ} (hβ : IsCantor β n) : Independent β n

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.normalized_eq_sqAddIter
items.doc: For a Cantor basis, W^_j = W_j: the normalisation divides by one.
items.statement:
theorem normalized_eq_sqAddIter {n : ℕ} (hβ : IsCantor β n) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < n) (x : F) :
    normalized β j x = sqAddIter j x

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.twiddle_cantor
items.doc: For a Cantor basis, the twiddle is W_j(shift) plus point(2b).
items.statement:
theorem twiddle_cantor {n : ℕ} (hβ : IsCantor β n) (shift : F) {j b : ℕ} (hj : j < n)
    (hb : b * 2 ^ (j + 1) < 2 ^ n) :
    twiddle β shift j b = sqAddIter j shift + point β (2 * b)

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.stage_offset
items.statement:
theorem stage_offset (τ : ℕ → F) (j c : ℕ) (x : ℕ → V) (i : ℕ) :
    stage τ j x (i + c * 2 ^ (j + 1)) =
      stage (fun b => τ (b + c)) j (fun r => x (r + c * 2 ^ (j + 1))) i

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.istage_offset
items.statement:
theorem istage_offset (τ : ℕ → F) (j c : ℕ) (x : ℕ → V) (i : ℕ) :
    istage τ j x (i + c * 2 ^ (j + 1)) =
      istage (fun b => τ (b + c)) j (fun r => x (r + c * 2 ^ (j + 1))) i

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.stage_congr
items.statement:
theorem stage_congr {τ τ' : ℕ → F} {j c : ℕ} {x x' : ℕ → V} (hτ : ∀ b < c, τ b = τ' b)
    (hx : ∀ i < c * 2 ^ (j + 1), x i = x' i) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < c * 2 ^ (j + 1)) :
    stage τ j x i = stage τ' j x' i

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.istage_congr
items.statement:
theorem istage_congr {τ τ' : ℕ → F} {j c : ℕ} {x x' : ℕ → V} (hτ : ∀ b < c, τ b = τ' b)
    (hx : ∀ i < c * 2 ^ (j + 1), x i = x' i) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < c * 2 ^ (j + 1)) :
    istage τ j x i = istage τ' j x' i

items.note: ## The inverse network undoes the forward network

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.istage_stage
items.statement: theorem istage_stage (τ : ℕ → F) (j : ℕ) (x : ℕ → V) : istage τ j (stage τ j x) = x

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.stage_istage
items.statement: theorem stage_istage (τ : ℕ → F) (j : ℕ) (x : ℕ → V) : stage τ j (istage τ j x) = x

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.inetwork_network
items.doc: The inverse network undoes the forward network, for any twiddles.
items.statement:
theorem inetwork_network (τ : ℕ → ℕ → F) (l : ℕ) (x : ℕ → V) :
    inetwork τ l (network τ l x) = x

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.network_inetwork
items.doc: The forward network undoes the inverse network, for any twiddles.
items.statement:
theorem network_inetwork (τ : ℕ → ℕ → F) (l : ℕ) (x : ℕ → V) :
    network τ l (inetwork τ l x) = x

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.network_twiddle_congr
items.doc: The network only reads the twiddles of its l stages.
items.statement:
theorem network_twiddle_congr {τ τ' : ℕ → ℕ → F} {l : ℕ} (h : ∀ j < l, τ j = τ' j)
    (x : ℕ → V) : network τ l x = network τ' l x

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.blocks_succ
items.statement:
theorem blocks_succ {c l j : ℕ} (hj : j < l) :
    c * 2 ^ (l + 1 - 1 - j) = 2 * c * 2 ^ (l - 1 - j)

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.network_congr
items.doc: The rows of c whole blocks of 2^l depend only on those rows and their blocks' twiddles.
items.statement:
theorem network_congr {τ τ' : ℕ → ℕ → F} {l c : ℕ} {x x' : ℕ → V}
    (hτ : ∀ j < l, ∀ b < c * 2 ^ (l - 1 - j), τ j b = τ' j b)
    (hx : ∀ i < c * 2 ^ l, x i = x' i) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < c * 2 ^ l) :
    network τ l x i = network τ' l x' i

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.inetwork_congr
items.statement:
theorem inetwork_congr {τ τ' : ℕ → ℕ → F} {l c : ℕ} {x x' : ℕ → V}
    (hτ : ∀ j < l, ∀ b < c * 2 ^ (l - 1 - j), τ j b = τ' j b)
    (hx : ∀ i < c * 2 ^ l, x i = x' i) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < c * 2 ^ l) :
    inetwork τ l x i = inetwork τ' l x' i

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.network_offset
items.doc:
Past c whole blocks of 2^l, the network is that of the rows above.

The blocks are renumbered from zero.
items.statement:
theorem network_offset (τ : ℕ → ℕ → F) (l c : ℕ) (x : ℕ → V) (i : ℕ) :
    network τ l x (i + c * 2 ^ l) =
      network (fun j b => τ j (b + c * 2 ^ (l - 1 - j))) l (fun r => x (r + c * 2 ^ l)) i

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.inetwork_twiddle_congr
items.statement:
theorem inetwork_twiddle_congr {τ τ' : ℕ → ℕ → F} {l : ℕ} (h : ∀ j < l, τ j = τ' j)
    (x : ℕ → V) : inetwork τ l x = inetwork τ' l x

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.inetwork_offset
items.doc:
Past c whole blocks of 2^l, the inverse network is that of the rows above.

The blocks are renumbered from zero.
items.statement:
theorem inetwork_offset (τ : ℕ → ℕ → F) (l c : ℕ) (x : ℕ → V) (i : ℕ) :
    inetwork τ l x (i + c * 2 ^ l) =
      inetwork (fun j b => τ j (b + c * 2 ^ (l - 1 - j))) l (fun r => x (r + c * 2 ^ l)) i

items.note: ## The top stage of a network of 2^(l+1) rows

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.stage_top_low
items.statement:
theorem stage_top_low (τ : ℕ → F) (l : ℕ) (d : ℕ → V) {k : ℕ} (hk : k < 2 ^ l) :
    stage τ l d k = d k + τ 0 • d (k + 2 ^ l)

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.stage_top_high
items.statement:
theorem stage_top_high (τ : ℕ → F) (l : ℕ) (d : ℕ → V) {k : ℕ} (hk : k < 2 ^ l) :
    stage τ l d (k + 2 ^ l) = d k + τ 0 • d (k + 2 ^ l) + d (k + 2 ^ l)

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.novelEval_congr
items.statement:
theorem novelEval_congr (β : ℕ → F) (l : ℕ) {d d' : ℕ → V} (h : ∀ k < 2 ^ l, d k = d' k)
    (x : F) : novelEval β l d x = novelEval β l d' x

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.novelEval_succ
items.doc: Splitting the novel basis at bit l: sum_k d_k X_k = P_0 + W^_l P_1.
items.statement:
theorem novelEval_succ (β : ℕ → F) (l : ℕ) (d : ℕ → V) (x : F) :
    novelEval β (l + 1) d x =
      novelEval β l d x + normalized β l x • novelEval β l (fun k => d (k + 2 ^ l)) x

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.novelEval_add_smul
items.statement:
theorem novelEval_add_smul (β : ℕ → F) (l : ℕ) (a b : ℕ → V) (t x : F) :
    novelEval β l (fun k => a k + t • b k) x = novelEval β l a x + t • novelEval β l b x

items.note: ## The network computes the additive NTT

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.twiddle_upper
items.doc: The twiddles of the upper half are those of the coset shifted by beta_l.
items.statement:
theorem twiddle_upper (β : ℕ → F) (shift : F) {l j b : ℕ} (hj : j < l)
    (hb : b < 2 ^ (l - 1 - j)) :
    twiddle β shift j (b + 1 * 2 ^ (l - 1 - j)) = twiddle β (shift + β l) j b

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.network_ntt
items.doc:
Lin, Chung and Han, section III: the network computes the additive NTT.

The twiddles are W^_j at the block points, and the basis is independent.
items.statement:
theorem network_ntt (β : ℕ → F) {n l : ℕ} (hβ : Independent β n) (hl : l ≤ n) (shift : F)
    (d : ℕ → V) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < 2 ^ l) :
    network (twiddle β shift) l d i = ntt β l shift d i

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.inetwork_ntt
items.doc: The inverse network recovers the coefficients from the values on the coset.
items.statement:
theorem inetwork_ntt (β : ℕ → F) {n l : ℕ} (hβ : Independent β n) (hl : l ≤ n) (shift : F)
    (d y : ℕ → V) (hy : ∀ i < 2 ^ l, y i = ntt β l shift d i) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < 2 ^ l) :
    inetwork (twiddle β shift) l y i = d i

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.novelEval_pad
items.statement:
theorem novelEval_pad (β : ℕ → F) {m : ℕ} (d : ℕ → V) (hd : ∀ k, 2 ^ m ≤ k → d k = 0) (r : ℕ)
    (x : F) : novelEval β (m + r) d x = novelEval β m d x

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.ntt_pad
items.doc: Coefficients zero from 2^m on: row c 2^m + i over S_(m+r) is row i over point(c 2^m) + S_m.
items.statement:
theorem ntt_pad (β : ℕ → F) {m : ℕ} (r : ℕ) (shift : F) (d : ℕ → V)
    (hd : ∀ k, 2 ^ m ≤ k → d k = 0) (c : ℕ) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < 2 ^ m) :
    ntt β (m + r) shift d (c * 2 ^ m + i) = ntt β m (shift + point β (c * 2 ^ m)) d i

modules.title: The coset transform agrees with the existing additive NTT
modules.doc:
The coset file indexes the basis by natural numbers and evaluates at points.

The existing development works with polynomials over a finite field, and a basis indexed by `Fin r`.

This file shows the two presentations compute the same thing.

A natural-number basis `b` stands for `β` when it agrees with it below `r`.

## Main results

- `vanishing_eq_eval_W`: the point-indexed W_i is the evaluation of the polynomial W_i.
- `normalized_eq_eval_normalizedW`: the same for the normalised W^_i.
- `novel_eq_eval_Xⱼ`: the same for the novel basis polynomial X_j.
- `novelEval_eq_eval_polynomialFromNovelCoeffs`: the same for a polynomial in the novel basis.
- `independent_of_linearIndependent`: a linearly independent basis is independent.
- `additiveNTT_eq_ntt`: the existing transform is the coset transform with zero shift.
- `inetwork_additiveNTT`: the inverse network undoes the existing transform.

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.point_eq_sum_getBit
items.doc: Point k below 2^i is the sum the existing code forms from the bits of k.
items.statement:
theorem point_eq_sum_getBit (hb : ∀ i : Fin r, b i = β i) (i : Fin r) (k : Fin (2 ^ i.val)) :
    point b k = ∑ j : Fin i, if Nat.getBit j k == 1 then β ⟨j, by omega⟩ else 0

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.vanishing_eq_eval_W
items.doc: The point-indexed W_i is the evaluation of the polynomial W_i.
items.statement:
theorem vanishing_eq_eval_W [Fact (LinearIndependent 𝔽q β)] (hb : ∀ i : Fin r, b i = β i)
    (i : Fin r) (x : L) : vanishing b i x = (W 𝔽q β i).eval x

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.normalized_eq_eval_normalizedW
items.doc: The point-indexed W^_i is the evaluation of the polynomial W^_i.
items.statement:
theorem normalized_eq_eval_normalizedW [Fact (LinearIndependent 𝔽q β)]
    (hb : ∀ i : Fin r, b i = β i) (i : Fin r) (x : L) :
    normalized b i x = (normalizedW 𝔽q β i).eval x

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.novel_eq_eval_Xⱼ
items.doc: The point-indexed X_j is the evaluation of the novel basis polynomial X_j.
items.statement:
theorem novel_eq_eval_Xⱼ [Fact (LinearIndependent 𝔽q β)] [Fact (Nat.Prime (ringChar 𝔽q))]
    (hb : ∀ i : Fin r, b i = β i) {ℓ : ℕ} (h_ℓ : ℓ ≤ r) (j : Fin (2 ^ ℓ)) (x : L) :
    novel b ℓ j x = (Xⱼ 𝔽q β ℓ h_ℓ j).eval x

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.novelEval_eq_eval_polynomialFromNovelCoeffs
items.doc: A polynomial in the novel basis has the same value in both presentations.
items.statement:
theorem novelEval_eq_eval_polynomialFromNovelCoeffs [Fact (LinearIndependent 𝔽q β)]
    [Fact (Nat.Prime (ringChar 𝔽q))] (hb : ∀ i : Fin r, b i = β i) {ℓ : ℕ} (h_ℓ : ℓ ≤ r)
    (a : Fin (2 ^ ℓ) → L) (d : ℕ → L) (hd : ∀ k : Fin (2 ^ ℓ), d k = a k) (x : L) :
    novelEval b ℓ d x = (polynomialFromNovelCoeffs 𝔽q β ℓ h_ℓ a).eval x

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.independent_of_linearIndependent
items.doc: A linearly independent basis is independent in the sense of the coset file.
items.statement:
theorem independent_of_linearIndependent [Fact (LinearIndependent 𝔽q β)]
    (hb : ∀ i : Fin r, b i = β i) : Independent b r

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.evaluationPointω_eq_point
items.doc: With beta_0 = 1, the evaluation points of the existing transform are the points of S.
items.statement:
theorem evaluationPointω_eq_point [Fact (β 0 = 1)] {ℓ R_rate : ℕ} (hb : ∀ i : Fin r, b i = β i)
    (h : ℓ + R_rate < r) (j : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ + R_rate))) :
    evaluationPointω 𝔽q β h (i := ⟨0, by omega⟩) (h_i := Nat.zero_le ℓ) j = point b j

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.additiveNTT_eq_ntt
items.doc:
The existing transform is the coset transform with zero shift.

The coefficients `d` extend `a` past 2^l in any way.
items.statement:
theorem additiveNTT_eq_ntt (hb : ∀ i : Fin r, b i = β i) (h : ℓ + R_rate < r)
    (a : Fin (2 ^ ℓ) → L) (d : ℕ → L) (hd : ∀ k : Fin (2 ^ ℓ), d k = a k)
    (j : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ + R_rate))) :
    additiveNTT 𝔽q β h a j = ntt b ℓ 0 d j

items.name: AdditiveNTT.Coset.inetwork_additiveNTT
items.doc:
The inverse network undoes the existing transform.

It reads the first 2^l outputs and returns the coefficients.
items.statement:
theorem inetwork_additiveNTT (hb : ∀ i : Fin r, b i = β i) (h : ℓ + R_rate < r)
    (a : Fin (2 ^ ℓ) → L) (d : ℕ → L) (hd : ∀ k : Fin (2 ^ ℓ), d k = a k) (y : ℕ → L)
    (hy : ∀ j : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ + R_rate)), y j = additiveNTT 𝔽q β h a j) {i : ℕ}
    (hi : i < 2 ^ ℓ) : inetwork (twiddle b 0) ℓ y i = d i

modules.title: Additive NTT Domains
modules.doc:
Domain-level constructions for the Additive NTT: quotient maps, intermediate
domains, and the finite-domain bijections used by the algorithm.

items.name: AdditiveNTT.𝔽q_element_eq_zero_or_eq_one
items.statement: lemma 𝔽q_element_eq_zero_or_eq_one : ∀ c : 𝔽q, c = 0 ∨ c = 1

items.name: AdditiveNTT.sDomain
items.statement: noncomputable def sDomain (i : Fin r) : Subspace 𝔽q L

items.name: AdditiveNTT.qMap
items.statement: noncomputable def qMap (i : Fin r) (h_i_add_1 : i.val + 1 < r) : L[X]

items.name: AdditiveNTT.natDegree_qMap
items.statement:
lemma natDegree_qMap (i : Fin r) (h_i_add_1 : i.val + 1 < r) :
    (qMap 𝔽q β i h_i_add_1).natDegree = 2

items.name: AdditiveNTT.qMap_ne_zero
items.statement:
lemma qMap_ne_zero (i : Fin r) (h_i_add_1 : i.val + 1 < r) :
    (qMap 𝔽q β i h_i_add_1) ≠ 0

items.name: AdditiveNTT.degree_qMap
items.statement:
lemma degree_qMap (i : Fin r) (h_i_add_1 : i.val + 1 < r) :
    (qMap 𝔽q β i h_i_add_1).degree = 2

items.name: AdditiveNTT.qMap_eval_𝔽q_eq_0
items.statement:
theorem qMap_eval_𝔽q_eq_0 (i : Fin r) (h_i_add_1 : i.val + 1 < r) :
    ∀ c : 𝔽q, (qMap 𝔽q β i h_i_add_1).eval (algebraMap 𝔽q L c) = 0

items.name: AdditiveNTT.qMap_comp_normalizedW
items.statement:
lemma qMap_comp_normalizedW (i : Fin r) (h_i_add_1 : i.val + 1 < r) :
    (qMap 𝔽q β i h_i_add_1).comp (normalizedW 𝔽q β i) =
      normalizedW 𝔽q β ⟨i.val + 1, h_i_add_1⟩

items.name: AdditiveNTT.qMap_is_linear_map
items.statement:
theorem qMap_is_linear_map (i : Fin r) (h_i_add_1 : i.val + 1 < r) :
    IsLinearMap 𝔽q (f := fun inner_p ↦ (qMap 𝔽q β i h_i_add_1).comp inner_p)

items.name: AdditiveNTT.qMap_maps_sDomain
items.statement:
theorem qMap_maps_sDomain (i : Fin r) (h_i_add_1 : i.val + 1 < r) :
    have q_comp_linear_map := qMap_is_linear_map 𝔽q β i h_i_add_1
    have q_eval_linear_map := linear_map_of_comp_to_linear_map_of_eval
      (f := qMap 𝔽q β i h_i_add_1) q_comp_linear_map
    let q_i_map := polyEvalLinearMap (qMap 𝔽q β i h_i_add_1) q_eval_linear_map
    let S_i := sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i
    let S_i_plus_1 := sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i.val + 1, h_i_add_1⟩
    Submodule.map q_i_map S_i = S_i_plus_1

items.name: AdditiveNTT.qCompositionChain
items.statement: noncomputable def qCompositionChain (i : Fin r) : L[X]

items.name: AdditiveNTT.qCompositionChain_eq_foldl
items.statement:
lemma qCompositionChain_eq_foldl (i : Fin r) :
    qCompositionChain 𝔽q β (ℓ := ℓ) (R_rate := R_rate) i =
      Fin.foldl (n := i) (fun acc j =>
        (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨j, by omega⟩ (by change j.val + 1 < r; omega)).comp acc) X

items.name: AdditiveNTT.normalizedW_eq_qMap_composition
items.statement:
lemma normalizedW_eq_qMap_composition (ℓ R_rate : ℕ) (i : Fin r) :
    normalizedW 𝔽q β i = qCompositionChain 𝔽q β (ℓ := ℓ) (R_rate := R_rate) i
